blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.
blocks.zh: 精确模拟硬体相互作用对于预测物理世界模型至关重要。 尽管最近在建立物体动态模型方面取得了进展,但捕捉到表面形状物体运动之间的局部接触仍然具有挑战性。 虽然端对端世界模型预测整个场景或物体之间的相互作用,但在实践中,刚性的身体接触是内在局部的,只有附近的表面才能直接交换接触力. 基于这一观察,我们引入了Ridid-body Contact Reasoning(RiCo),它代表了物体之间通过接触面点的稀疏的邻里进行的相互作用. RiCo将每个点的状态与附近表面的相对几何,运动,和物理属性结合起来,然后在物体的点之间找出原因来确定这些局部接触如何共同影响其运动. 通过将交叉对象推理限制在附近的表面,同时在每个刚性体内传播接触信息,RiCo保留了精细的刻度互动细节,而无需花费每对场景点的建模成本. 此类属性使RiCo具有更高的准确性和接触忠诚性. MOVi-beckmark上的实验表明,与基线相比,RiCo将100帧位置和方向误差分别减少31-35%和约38%. 此外,RiCo实现了高度接触忠诚,地面-相对渗透时间和平均深度分别为11.0%和2.22毫米。 RiCo进一步将零镜头从小规模训练场景概括到包含270个物体的场景. 我们的现实世界的多球碰撞实验进一步提供了模拟到实际转移的初步证据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
High-fidelity modeling of the physical world has become a central milestone in embodied AI, enabling agents to reason about how environments evolve and respond to their interactions ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
Recent advances in world models have learned predictive representations from large-scale video observations ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond these visual patterns, however, the physical world exhibits complex dynamics involving spatial motion, object geometry, and contact interactions ( Hafner et al., 2023 ) , which remain difficult to capture with video generation backbones.
To advance the modeling of dynamic objects, we study neural simulation of rigid-body motions, including translation, rotation, and interactions among multiple objects in 3D space ( Chang et al., 2016 ; Wei and Fink, 2025 ) .
As a fundamental abstraction of physical object motion, rigid-body dynamics exclude continuous deformation of objects, but introduce a significant challenge in modelling their interactions under different geometric form and motion conditions,
because collisions introduce abrupt changes in linear and angular velocities, making contact dynamics non-smooth and challenging to predict accurately ( Pfaff et al., 2020 ; Wei and Fink, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
实体世界的高度诚信模型化已成为体现的AI中的核心里程碑,它使代理人能够了解环境如何演变并应对其相互作用(Agarwal等,2025年)。
世界模型的最新进展已经从大规模视频观测中吸取了预测性表现(Bruce等,2024;Ye等,2026;Li等,2026.).
然而,除这些视觉模式外,物理世界还表现出涉及空间运动、物体几何和接触相互作用的复杂动态(Hafner等,2023年),这些动态仍然难以用视频生成主干来捕捉。
为了推进动态物体的建模,我们研究了刚性体运动的神经模拟,包括3D空间中多个物体之间的翻译,旋转和相互作用(Chan等,2016;Wei和Fink,2025).
作为物理物体运动的基本抽象,刚性-体动力学排除了物体的持续变形,但在不同几何形式和运动条件下的相互作用建模方面提出了重大挑战,
因为碰撞带来了线性和角速度的突然变化,使接触动力学变得不流畅,难以准确预测(Pfaff等人,2020年;Wei和Fink,2025年)。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, prior works proposed learning neural approximations of motion dynamics from observed trajectories ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Brandstetter et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) .
Despite their success across various domains, modeling rigid-body dynamics remains challenging because collisions may induce abrupt changes in objects’ velocities and subsequent motion trajectories.
To better capture these discontinuities, recent studies incorporate geometric priors to explicitly model contact interactions.
For instance, mesh-based neural simulators exploit mesh connectivity and surface geometry to propagate information about physical interactions ( Pfaff et al., 2020 ; Allen et al., 2023 ) .
HOPNet ( Wei and Fink, 2025 ) further incorporates higher-order topological structures to improve the modeling of rigid-body contact dynamics.
However, processing mesh connectivity and constructing high-order geometric relationships can be computationally expensive and time-consuming.
Therefore, RigidFormer ( Dou et al., 2026 ) represents individual objects using point sets and models their interactions through object-level attention, enabling rigid-body simulation without explicit mesh connectivity.
While point clouds can efficiently capture surface geometry, they do not inherently encode which surface points may come into contact during object interactions.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,先前的作品提出了从所观察到的轨迹中学习运动动力学的神经近似值(Hafner等,2019;Brandstetter等,2022;Wu等,2023).
尽管在各个领域都取得了成功,但僵硬体动力学的建模仍然具有挑战性,因为相撞可能导致物体速度和随后的运动轨迹发生突变。
为了更好地捕捉这些不连续现象,最近的研究包含了几何学前科,以明确模拟接触相互作用。
例如,网状神经模拟器利用网状连接和地表几何来传播物理相互作用的信息(Pfaff等人,2020年;Allen等人,2023年)。
HOPNet (Wei and Fink, 2025)进一步融入了高阶地貌结构来改进刚性体接触动力学的建模.
然而,处理网状连接和构建高序几何关系在计算上可能很昂贵和费时.
因此,僵硬前锋 (Dou等人,2026年)代表单个物体使用点集并模型通过对象层次的注意来进行相互作用,使得刚性-体模拟没有明显的网格连接.
虽然点云可以高效地捕捉地表几何,但它们并没有内在地表点在物体相互作用时接触的编码.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparing rigid body contact modeling.
blocks.zh: 图1:比较刚性身体接触模型。

blocks.en:
Striving for efficient and fine-grained contact modeling, we propose RiCo  which identifies and models local contact relationships directly from point-cloud representations, without relying on mesh connectivity. Figure 1 shows an illustrative example.
This approach reflects the local nature of rigid-body interactions: only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) .
Accordingly, instead of modeling the dense interactions among all objects,
RiCo identifies only potential contact points and models their local dynamics across interacting objects.
Because the combined effects of these contacts can govern rigid-body motion, we reason over contact information by propagating the effects of local contacts across rigid body.
The intra-object contact reasoning provides a principled link between fine-grained interactions and whole-object motion. This design not only supports generalization across diverse shapes but also scales efficiently as the number of surface points grows.
blocks.zh:
努力建立高效和精细的接触模式,我们提议RiCo, 直接从点-云的表示来识别和模拟本地的接触关系,而不依赖于网状连接。 图1是一个示例。
这种方法反映了刚性-体相互作用的局部性质:只有附近的地表才能直接交换接触力(Sanchez-Gonzalez等,2020.).
因此,不模拟所有物体之间的密集相互作用,
RiCo只识别出潜在联络点,并模拟其相互作用对象的局部动态。
由于这些接触的综合效应可以制约僵硬的身体运动,所以我们通过在僵硬的身体中传播地方接触的效果来解释联系信息。
物体内接触推理提供了精细的相互作用和整体物体运动之间的原则联系. 这种设计不仅支持跨不同形状的通缩,而且随着地表点数的增加,也有效尺度.

blocks.en:
To implement RiCo, we build a neural simulator that decomposes object-level collisions into sparse local contacts and intra-object contact reasoning.
For each surface point, RiCo constructs a compact contact neighborhood containing nearby points from other objects and the environment.
It then combines the source point’s state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of these contact candidates to form contact-conditioned point features.
Based on such features, a point transformer attends each surface point to the others on the target object, so the model can reason where contacts occur, how the contacting surfaces move, and how forces at different locations affect translation and rotation.
Based on these contact-conditioned features, an anchor-based decoder predicts motion updates at a small set of surface points, from which a single rigid transformation is recovered and applied to the entire object.
This design integrates fine-grained geometric information into contact-dynamics reasoning, thereby generating physically plausible rigid-body motion.
blocks.zh:
为了实施RiCo,我们建造了一个神经模拟器,将对象级相撞分解为稀少的局部接触和对象内接触推理.
对于每个地表点,RiCo构建一个紧凑的接触区,包含来自其他物体和环境的相邻点.
然后将源点状态与这些接触对象的相对几何,运动和物理特性结合起来,形成联系条件的点特征.
基于这些特征,一个点变压器会在每个地平面上向目标物体上的其他地平面指向,因此模型可以说明接触发生地,接触地平面如何移动,不同地平面上的力量如何影响翻译和旋转.
基于这些接触条件的特征,一个基于锚地的解码器在一小组地表点上预测运动更新,从中恢复出单一的刚性变换并应用于整个物体.
这种设计将精细的几何信息整合到接触力学推理中,从而产生物理上可行的刚性-身体运动.

blocks.en:
We conduct extensive experiments on the MOVi benchmark ( Greff et al., 2022 ) to evaluate RiCo in terms of prediction accuracy, generalization, contact fidelity, scalability, and real-world dynamics.
Across diverse object configurations and long-horizon rollouts, RiCo reduces position and orientation errors by up to 35% and 38%, respectively.
Beyond conventional trajectory metrics, we assess contact fidelity by comparing the predicted and ground-truth trajectories’ aggregate penetration-time ratios and mean penetration depths, thereby accounting for geometric overlap already present in the ground-truth trajectories.
Under this metric, RiCo reduces relative contact violations to 11.0% of object-time steps, with an average relative penetration depth of 2.22 mm.
Moreover, RiCo generalizes effectively across unseen distributions of 270 objects.
We further investigate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer through real-world multi-ball billiard collision experiments, providing preliminary evidence that the learned contact dynamics can generalize to real-world multi-object interactions without additional training.
These results demonstrate that local contact reasoning enables accurate, contact-fidelity, and scalable neural simulation of complex rigid-body dynamics.
blocks.zh:
我们在MOVi基准(Greff等,2022年)上进行了广泛的实验,从预测的准确性,概括性,接触忠诚性,可伸缩性,以及现实世界的动态等方面来评价RiCo.
在整个不同的对象配置和长视距展开中,RiCo将位置和方向错误分别减少35%和38%.
除了常规的轨迹衡量标准外,我们通过比较预测的和地面真实轨迹的总穿透率和平均穿入深度来评估接触忠诚度,从而计算出地面真实轨迹中已经存在的几何重叠。
在这个度量下,RiCo将相对接触违规率降低到11.0%的物体时间步骤,平均相对穿透深度为2.22毫米.
此外,里科还有效地概括了270个物体的无形分布。
我们进一步调查通过现实世界多球台球相撞实验实现的零弹射成正向活性转移,提供初步证据表明所学的接触动力学可以在没有额外训练的情况下被概括为现实世界多物体相互作用.
这些结果显示,局部的接触推理能够使复杂的刚性-体能动态的准确性,接触性-真性,可伸缩性神经模拟.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned Models of Physical Dynamics. Learned world models predict future environment states from observations, ranging from latent dynamics models ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ) to feature-space predictive approaches such as I-JEPA and DINO-WM ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Recent work adopts explicit 3D representations for embodied prediction: PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) models action-conditioned scene evolution with 3D point flows, while RoboFlow4D ( Lin et al., 2026 ) predicts multi-frame 3D motion fields for robotic manipulation. Despite this progress, rigid-body contact remains challenging because interactions can induce abrupt changes in global object motion, resulting in discontinuous dynamics that are difficult for smooth learned predictors to capture ( Allen et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 学习的物理动力模型。 所学出的世界模型预测未来环境状态,从观测,从潜在动态模型(Ha和Schmidhuber,2018;Hafner等人,2019)到I-JEPA和DINO-WM等地物-空间预测方法(Asran等人,2023;Zhou等人,2024). 近期的工作采用明确的三维表示,用于反映的预测: Point World (Huang等,2026年) 模型以3D点流为条件的场景演化,而RoboFlow4D (Lin等,2026年) 预测多帧3D运动场用于机器人操纵. 尽管取得了这一进展,但僵硬的身体接触仍然具有挑战性,因为相互作用可能诱发全球物体运动的突然变化,导致不连续的动态,而光滑的已学会的预测器难以捕捉(Allen等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Geometric Representations for Rigid-Body Simulation. Early learned physics models introduced inductive biases for predicting physical interactions ( Battaglia et al., 2016 ; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2018 ) , which were later extended to particle-based simulators for objects and fluids ( Li et al., 2018 ; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) . Mesh-based approaches further exploit explicit geometric structure by performing message passing over simulation meshes ( Pfaff et al., 2020 ) . For rigid-body contact dynamics, FIGNet ( Allen et al., 2023 ) constructs interactions between mesh faces, preserving local surface geometry around contacts. Recent mesh-based models have explored hierarchical structures for propagating collision effects, while HOPNet ( Wei and Fink, 2025 ) explicitly represents vertices, edges, mesh triangles, contacts, and objects through higher-order topological relations. To relax the dependence on meshes, SDF-Sim ( Rubanova et al., 2024 ) represents object geometry using learned signed-distance functions, whereas RigidFormer ( Dou et al., 2026 ) removes mesh connectivity entirely and operates on point-cloud inputs. Our method follows the mesh-free setting, while retaining point-level geometry for sparse local contact reasoning rather than compressing interactions primarily into coarse object-level representations.
blocks.zh: 硬-Body模拟的几何表示. 早期所学的物理模型引入了预测物理相互作用的诱导偏差(Battaglia等,2016;Sanchez-Gonzalez等,2018),后被扩展为以粒子为基的物体和流体模拟器(Li等,2018;Sanchez-Gonzalez等,2020.). 基于网格的方法通过传递模拟网格的信息来进一步利用明显的几何结构(Pfaff等人,2020年)。 对于刚性-身体接触动力学,FIGNet(Allen等,2023年)构建了网面之间的相互作用,在接触周围保留了局部地表几何. 最近基于网格的模型探索了传播相撞效应的分级结构,而HOPNet(Wei and Fink,2025)则通过高阶地貌关系明确代表了顶点,边缘,网格三角,接触和对象. 为了放松对 meshes 的依赖,SDF-Sim(Rubanova等,2024年)是使用已学到的签名-距离函数表示对象几何的,而RigidFormer(Dou等,2026年)则完全去除网状连接并运行在点-云输入上. 我们的方法遵循无网格设置,同时保留点级几何来进行稀少的局部接触推理,而不是主要将相互作用压缩为粗细的对象级表示.

blocks.en: 3.1 Sparse Contact Neighborhood Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 社区联系人代表

blocks.en:
Contact neighborhood construction. Striving for concise representation of contact dynamics, we construct a sparse local interaction representation around each surface point, rather than modeling interactions over complete mesh-level or object-level representations ( Wei and Fink, 2025 ; Dou et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, we first perform an object-level broad-phase query over active object pairs using their surface-point AABBs, retaining only pairs whose minimum AABB separation is no greater than the contact radius ρ \rho .
More details can be found in appendix B.2 .
Candidates from all retained objects and the static environment ξ \xi are then combined, from which the K K nearest candidates within ρ \rho are retained. Dynamic-object candidates therefore correspond to sampled surface points rather than closest points on continuous meshes, while static planar surfaces are queried analytically by projection.
We denote the candidate positions by { y t , n , k i } k = 1 K \{y_{t,n,k}^{i}\}_{k=1}^{K} 1 1 1 If fewer than K K valid candidates exist, the remaining entries are padded and masked during subsequent aggregation; when no valid candidate exists, the entire contact neighborhood is masked and contributes zero contact information. .

While contact neighborhoods identify potential interactions between nearby surfaces, predicting the resulting rigid-body motion requires reasoning jointly about contacts across the object’s surface.
We therefore fuse local contact descriptors with each point’s state to form contact-conditioned tokens, then use a shared point Transformer to integrate these tokens within each object.

Anchor-based Motion Prediction. As a contact-aware neural simulator, RiCo predicts each rigid object’s future motion from its contact-conditioned tokens H t i H_{t}^{i} .
Since all surface points move under the same rigid transformation, predicting their future positions separately is often unnecessary.
To preserve rigidity, we follow prior anchor-based formulations ( Dou et al., 2026 ) and select A A anchor samples for each object using deterministic farthest point sampling (FPS) ( Qi et al., 2017 ) . The corresponding sample indices { n a i } a = 1 A \{n_{a}^{i}\}_{a=1}^{A} remain fixed throughout the rollout, such that the anchors track the same surface samples over time. We predict motion updates only at these anchors and use them to recover the rigid transformation of the entire object. Datasets & Metrics. We evaluate on MOVi-Sphere, MOVi-A, and MOVi-B ( Greff et al., 2022 ) . blocks.en: 4.1 Motion Prediction Performance Across Rollout Horizons
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨推出地平线的运动预测性能

blocks.en: We evaluate the autoregressive prediction accuracy of RiCo against various baselines across different object geometries and rollout horizons.
blocks.zh: 我们评估RiCo相对于不同物体地平面和展出地平线的各种基线的自旋性预测准确性。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 1 , RiCo consistently achieves lower position and orientation errors than all baselines on MOVi-A and MOVi-B across all evaluated horizons.
On MOVi-A, compared with the strongest baseline, our model reduces position RMSE by approximately 35% and orientation RMSE by 38–43% over 50–100 prediction steps. Similarly, on MOVi-B, we obtain a 31–32% reduction in position error and a 35–38% reduction in orientation error.
On the geometrically simpler MOVi-Sphere benchmark, our translational accuracy is comparable to RigidFormer, differing by at most 0.001 0.001 m at each horizon, while consistently achieving lower orientation error.
These results suggest that combining local contact representations with intra-object contact reasoning is particularly effective for predicting rigid-body interactions across diverse object shapes, while maintaining competitive performance in simpler spherical scenarios.
blocks.zh:
如表1所显示的,RiCo在所有评估的地平线上始终比MOVi-A和MOVi-B上的所有基线达到更低的位置和方向差.
在MOVi-A上,与最强的基线相比,我们的模型将RMSE的位置减少约35%,方向RMSE在50-100的预测步骤上减少38-43%. 同样,在MOVi-B上,我们得到了31-32 %的定位误差和35-38%的定向误差。
在几何简便的MOVi-Sphere基准上,我们的翻译精度与RigidFormer相当,在每个地平线上最多0.001,001米的不同,同时始终实现较低的方向误差.
这些结果表明,结合局部接触表示与对象内部接触推理,对于预测不同对象形状的刚性-体相互作用特别有效,同时在更简单的球形情景中保持有竞争力的性能.

blocks.en:
Notably, the prediction improvements persist throughout the evaluated autoregressive rollout horizons.
At 100 frames, RiCo achieves position and orientation RMSEs of 0.115 0.115 m/ 11.40 ∘ 11.40^{\circ} on MOVi-A and 0.111 0.111 m/ 9.54 ∘ 9.54^{\circ} on MOVi-B, respectively, substantially outperforming the corresponding baselines.
These results highlight the effectiveness of our contact-conditioned point Transformer, which integrates sparse local contact information through intra-object contact reasoning, for long-horizon rigid-body motion prediction.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,在整个经评估的自相递减的推出阶段,预测工作不断得到改进。
在100帧上,RiCo在MOVi-A上分别达到0.115 0.115 m/ 11.40 ∘ 11.40 ^{\ Circ}和在MOVi-B上分别达到0.111 0.111 m/ 9.54 ∘ 9.54 ^{\ Circ}的位置和方向RMSE,在相当程度上超过了相应的基线.
这些结果凸显出我们具有接触条件的点变换器的有效性,它通过对象内接触推理将稀少的局部联系信息集成在一起,用于长视刚体运动预测.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generalization Across Object Geometries
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨越对象地貌的泛化

blocks.en:
A useful rigid-body dynamics model must predict interactions across diverse object geometries, including shapes that differ from those in its training data.
We therefore evaluate how well dynamics learned from one geometry distribution transfer to another.

一个有用的刚体动力学模型必须预测不同物体几何体之间的相互作用,包括与其训练数据不同的形状。
因此,我们评价从一个几何分布转移到另一个几何的动态学的好坏。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 ,
RiCo exhibits an asymmetric generalization
pattern, with particularly strong performance when
transferring from geometrically diverse training
distributions to simpler ones. When trained on the geometrically diverse MOVi-B dataset, our model transfers particularly well to its simpler constituent distributions. From MOVi-B to MOVi-Sphere, our 100-step position RMSE is 0.085 0.085 m, compared with 0.160 0.160 m for HopNet and 0.207 0.207 m for RigidFormer. Similarly, from MOVi-B to MOVi-A, our error is 0.112 0.112 m/ 11.26 ∘ 11.26^{\circ} , substantially lower than both baselines. Notably, the additional geometry diversity in MOVi-B does not lead to negative transfer on simpler shapes. We observe similar improvements when transferring
from MOVi-A to MOVi-Sphere. In contrast, generalization from geometrically restricted training distributions to more diverse target distributions remains challenging. When transferring from MOVi-A to MOVi-B, RiCo achieves the lowest position error, although RigidFormer retains a slightly lower orientation error.
When trained exclusively on MOVi-Sphere, our method does not consistently outperform RigidFormer on the more geometrically diverse MOVi-A and MOVi-B benchmarks.

blocks.en: 4.3 In-Depth Study on the Contact Fidelity
blocks.zh: 4.3 关于联系的深入研究

blocks.en: While trajectory RMSE measures prediction accuracy, it does not directly measure the physical consistency of predicted interactions. To evaluate contact fidelity, we introduce ground-truth-relative penetration metrics. It accounts for the geometric overlaps that already present in ground-truth trajectories. Specifically, we report the differences in penetration-time ratio ( Δ \Delta PTR) and mean penetration depth ( Δ \Delta MPD) between predicted and ground-truth trajectories. Detailed implementation can be seen in appendix C.3 . For these analyses, we evaluate RiCo against the released HOPNet checkpoint and our independent RigidFormer reimplementation using the same penetration evaluation procedure. We further investigate the effects of signed geometric information, contact neighborhood size, and point-cloud resolution on prediction accuracy and contact fidelity. We also conduct runtime analysis on point-cloud resolution in appendix C.4 .

blocks.en: 4.5 Transfer from Simulated to Real-World Dynamics

blocks.en: To further investigate whether the learned local contact dynamics can generalize beyond simulated environments, we evaluate RiCo on real-world multi-ball collision experiments. In Figure 8 , our real-world experiments are conducted on a billiard table with an effective playing area of 2.54 × 1.27 2.54\times 1.27 m, using balls with a radius of 33.5 33.5 mm. We construct a corresponding simulated environment with comparable geometric configurations and train RiCo exclusively on simulated trajectories. The trained model is evaluated zero-shot on five real-world experimental sessions. Further details and qualitative results of the experimental setup and simulation environment are provided in the appendix C.6 . Quantitatively, RiCo achieves position RMSEs of 138.54 138.54 , 214.69 214.69 , and 272.42 272.42 mm at prediction horizons of 50, 75, and 100 frames. For reference, the physics engine achieves corresponding RMSEs of 65.37 65.37 , 147.84 147.84 , and 182.96 182.96 mm. We observe discrepancies when reconstructing real-world ball configurations in simulation using camera-estimated positions, suggesting that camera-based localization inaccuracy is a major source of error in our sim-to-real evaluation. These results provide preliminary evidence that the contact dynamics learned through sparse local geometric reasoning can transfer from simulation to real-world multi-object interactions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce RiCo, a neural simulator that models rigid-body interactions through sparse local contact reasoning. By preserving fine-grained contact geometry while avoiding dense scene-level interactions, our approach achieves accurate and physically consistent predictions with high computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate its ability to exploit high-resolution geometry, generalize across diverse object distributions, scale to scenes containing 270 objects and transfer to real world. Nevertheless, our current framework focuses on passive rigid-body dynamics and does not account for deformable objects or actuated systems. Extending local contact reasoning to these more complex physical interactions remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了RiCo,一个神经模拟器,通过稀少的局部接触推理来模拟刚性-身体的相互作用. 通过保留精细的接触几何,同时避免密集的场景层相互作用,我们的方法以高计算效率实现准确而物理上一致的预测. 实验证明它有能力利用高分辨几何学,将各种物体分布进行通俗化,规模化到包含270个物体的场景并转移到现实世界. 然而,我们目前的框架侧重于被动僵硬的身体动态,而不考虑可变形物体或活化系统。 将本地接触推理扩展至这些更复杂的物理互动仍然是未来工作的一个重要方向.

blocks.en: Appendix A Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 问题陈述

blocks.en: A physical world model aims to capture how the physical environment evolves over time, enabling embodied agents to anticipate future states and reason about the consequences of their actions through predictive rollouts. Such predictive dynamics provide an important foundation for long-horizon reasoning, planning, and control, where an agent must evaluate possible future outcomes before acting. In physical environments, however, meaningful prediction requires not only modeling the motion of individual objects, but also reasoning about the interactions among them ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) . This is particularly important in multi-object rigid-body systems, where contact and collision govern the transfer of momentum and can induce abrupt changes in both translational and rotational motion. Accurately modeling collision dynamics is therefore a key capability for physical world models to move beyond simple motion extrapolation and faithfully predict the long-horizon evolution of interacting scenes.
blocks.zh: 物理世界模型旨在捕捉物理环境如何随时间演变,通过预测性的推出,使所包括的物剂能够预见未来状态及其行动后果的理由。 这种预测性动态为长远推理、规划和控制提供了重要基础,在这种基础上,代理人必须在采取行动之前评估未来可能的结果。 然而,在物理环境中,有意义的预测不仅需要模拟单个物体的运动,还需要对它们之间的相互作用进行推理(Sanchez-Gonzalez等,2020年)。 这一点在多物体刚体系统中尤其重要,在多物体刚体系统中,接触和相撞制约着动能的转移,并可诱发翻译和旋转运动的突然变化。 因此,精确地模拟相撞动态是物理世界模型超越简单运动外推的关键能力,并忠实地预测相互作用场景的长相演化.

blocks.en: Computational efficiency. We examine whether retaining high-resolution geometry introduces substantial computational overhead. As shown in Fig. 5 , we evaluate baselines and RiCo on the same 120 test trajectories using a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. Despite operating on 1024 surface points per object, RiCo achieves 47.89 47.89 FPS, slightly faster than our RigidFormer reimplementation ( 41.73 41.73 FPS) and over an order of magnitude faster than HOPNet ( 2.61 2.61 FPS). Reducing RiCo’s resolution to 512 and 256 points further increases throughput to 87.69 87.69 and 130.87 130.87 FPS, respectively. These results demonstrate that sparse local contact reasoning enables high-resolution geometric modeling without sacrificing computational efficiency.
